scope: SDevice-only electron-continuity balance and production-Jacobian audit at drain-adjacent free nodes

node_support.definition: all free endpoints of edges with exactly one endpoint in the drain contact node set

jacobian_partition.matrix: the production coupled-DD Jacobian evaluated at each frozen state
jacobian_partition.exact_partition: partition every nonzero production-Jacobian entry by psi/phin/phip and contact/free column
jacobian_partition.edge_derivative_control: retain the existing edge-projection transport derivative only as a non-closing diagnostic control because the SimpleMOS production mobility drive is transport_cell_vector

decision_questions: At the first free drain-adjacent nodes, is the imported-state electron residual created by contact-cut flux, internal flux, or local sources?
Does the exact incident-edge SG sum reproduce the raw continuity flux term?
Which variable and constrained/free column blocks dominate the production Jacobian row?
Can the full electron-phin row be reconstructed from incident-edge transport derivatives plus a local nontransport diagonal?
interpretation_limits: The audit evaluates both frozen states with the unchanged Vela operator; it does not expose a private Sentaurus Jacobian.
Raw continuity terms are separated before row weighting; the production Jacobian and residual retain configured row scaling.
The existing per-edge Jacobian probe constructs an edge-projection mobility drive and therefore is not used to reconstruct a transport-cell-vector production row.
Deep-off cancellation is retained as a condition-number diagnostic and is not used for headline HFS attribution.
